description: Cursor-Governance binding to the canonical memory control plane (l9-graphiti-memory). Read by ops/memory/runtime_binding.py, which proves the exact package, interpreter, and console script before any lifecycle call. This is a Cursor-owned statement of what Cursor expects to run; it grants nothing and resolves no provider. Production binding is an immutable release artifact locked in uv.lock; MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION is release 2.3.0 (cut at campaign stage M2 on the memory PR). source.ref is the v2.3.0 release tag on Quantum-L9/l9-graphiti-memory (annotated, cut 2026-09-07); release_evidence.memory_sha is the commit that tag resolves to, and the cross-repo proof resolves the tag and refuses any other commit. Integration installs the wheel built from that commit until uv.lock carries the published artifact.

source.ref_note: Release 2.3.0 = MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION. Annotated tag v2.3.0 (tag object 03ec559ca8e28b49c6763189363fc55400e3b09d, cut 2026-09-07 after Quantum-L9/l9-graphiti-memory#56 merged as 7691c07) resolves to 5605569b72baa25f6b6e6324b0017317fb31e0cd, the audit-closure head of #56: M2 (tag selector on search/hydrate, client cursor verify --path, installed-wheel lifecycle proof, shared control-plane fixture) plus the ADR-082 amendment (governed-candidate supersession, close replay forensics, coverage evidence). The tag is a name, not the proof: .github/workflows/memory-cross-repo.yml peels it and refuses a commit other than release_evidence.memory_sha, so a moved tag fails the proof instead of silently rebinding. Next step is the uv.lock pin of the published artifact.

binding_policy.production: exact release artifact locked in uv.lock; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.integration: exact git SHA above, installed as a built wheel into the governance environment; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.development: L9_MEMORY_DEV_CHECKOUT=<path to a l9-graphiti-memory checkout with .venv>; runtime_mode=development_checkout, never silent
forbidden: whatever l9-memory is first on PATH
an adjacent checkout discovered by directory scanning
pip install -e of a sibling checkout without the development opt-in

release_evidence.description: Exact-head proof of the binding (audit P1-01/P2-02). The wheel is built from source.ref with uv build --wheel under the fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH below and is byte-reproducible (the digest reproduced from a fresh clone of the same commit). .github/workflows/memory-cross-repo.yml rebuilds it from the same ref, refuses a digest mismatch, installs the wheel into a clean environment, and runs tests/ops/memory/test_cross_repo_lifecycle.py with L9_MEMORY_CROSS_REPO_REQUIRED=1 (a skip is a failure) and no provider credential in the environment. A digest here without that job green on the same Cursor head is a claim, not a proof.
release_evidence.rebound_at: 2026-09-07 (source.ref moved from the bare SHA to the v2.3.0 tag; memory_sha unchanged, digest unchanged)
operator_gated: uv.lock pin of the released artifact: blocked until publish.yml on the v2.3.0 tag succeeds; its first run (34132867942) was rejected by the l9-graphiti-memory `release` environment deployment policy, which does not allow tag v2.3.0 (allow tag pattern v* on that environment, then re-run the workflow)
